name: Application of the Federal Securities Laws to Certain Types of Crypto Assets and Certain Transactions Involving Crypto Assets
effective_state_note: Effective on its publication date of 23 March 2026.

goals_touched.what_the_source_raises: a classification covering digital commodities, digital collectibles, digital tools, stablecoins and digital securities, and application of the investment-contract analysis
which federal securities laws attach to which crypto asset transactions
treatment of protocol mining, protocol staking, wrapping and airdrops as distinct transaction types
